turns.t: Did you sign up for the robotics club?
I wanted to, but it meets on Tuesdays, and I have swimming practice then.
They're adding a Thursday group next month.
Really? Then I'll wait for that.

questions.q: Why hasn't Leo joined the robotics club yet?
o: The meeting is at the same time as his swimming practice
questions.why: He says it meets on Tuesdays and he has swimming practice then.

questions.q: What will Leo probably do next month?
questions.why: A Thursday group is being added and he says he'll wait for that.

turns.t: I stayed up late finishing my history project.
That's what I thought, but Mr. Ortiz moved the date.

questions.q: Why did Maya stay up late?
questions.why: Mr. Ortiz moved the date earlier.

turns.t: I can't find my calculator anywhere.
Then maybe you left it in the math room.
Oh! I think you're right. I'll go there after lunch.

questions.q: Where will Sofia look for her calculator?
questions.why: She has already checked her locker twice and will go to the math room after lunch.
She says, 'I'll go there after lunch.'

turns.t: Okay, class, before we start the experiment, please put on your safety glasses. Work in groups of three. One person will measure the water, one will record the temperature every two minutes, and one will write the notes. When you finish, wash your hands and return the equipment to the front table. Your lab report is due on Friday.

questions.why: She says to put on safety glasses before starting.

questions.q: What does the student who records do?
o: Writes down the temperature every two minutes
questions.why: One person records the temperature every two minutes.

questions.q: When is the lab report due?
questions.why: She says it is due on Friday.

turns.t: Good morning, students. This is an announcement from the office. Because of the rain, today's soccer practice has been moved from the field to the gym. Practice will start at four o'clock instead of three thirty. Please bring indoor shoes. Also, the library will close early today, at four fifteen. Thank you.

questions.q: Where will soccer practice be today?
questions.why: It has been moved from the field to the gym.
The announcer says to bring indoor shoes.

turns.t: Today we're going to talk about honeybees. A honeybee colony has three kinds of bees: one queen, hundreds of male drones, and thousands of female workers. The queen's only job is to lay eggs, sometimes up to two thousand in a single day. The workers do almost everything else. Young workers clean the hive and feed the babies. Older workers leave the hive to find flowers. When a worker finds a good flower, she returns and does a special dance. The direction of the dance tells the other bees where the flowers are.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the talk?
questions.why: He describes the kinds of bees and what each one does.
The queen's only job is to lay eggs.

questions.q: How do workers tell others where flowers are?
o: By flying in a circle around the hive
questions.why: The direction of the dance tells the bees where the flowers are.
